results.title: The Double
results.overview: Inspired by Andersen’s tale, The Double follows a Scientist who releases his shadow, only to see it gain autonomy, power, and eventually replace him. Across ten tableaux of about two minutes each, the 20–30 minute experience traces this transformation through a sequence of dreamlike scenes blending realism and abstraction.

results.title: The House
results.overview: For decades, Gabriel García Márquez envisioned a novel titled La Casa (The House), inspired by the home in Aracataca where he lived with his grandparents. Fragments emerged, but it was only after living in another house —in Mexico City— that he was able to develop the work that became Cien años de soledad (One Hundred Years of Solitude), his magnum opus. In this documentary directed by Eva Villaseñor, the writer’s sons, Rodrigo and Gonzalo García Barcha, return to their childhood home—a place where memory transforms time.

results.title: Nació Simón
results.overview: The beloved, unapologetic Lis/Simón lives between being a mother of two boys and a drag king performer. Navigating the spectrum of their own identity, Simón discovers that validation and their sense of self are much more than just a costume.

results.title: The Fisherman
results.overview: A retired traditional fisherman from Ghana. His life takes a whimsical turn when he is forced into retirement and partnered with a sarcastic talking fish, leading him on an adventure to Accra. Joined by his three quirky "Associates," they pursue their dream of owning a boat. Filled with laughter, magic, and the vibrant culture of Ghana, The Fisherman is a delightful tale of family, dreams, and the enduring spirit of a true fisherman.

results.title: The Wind Between Us
results.overview: Arman (40), who spent years in prison in Iran, travels to The Netherlands to finally meet his child (6) for the first time. While his wife heads off to work, father and child are left together in a park. They face each other as strangers, without a shared language. Yet slowly, the silence between them begins to give way to gestures, play, and tentative steps towards a fragile father-son bond.

results.title: DRUID
results.overview: 60 AD. Romans tighten their grip on Britannia. Druidism is hunted almost to extinction. after being driven out of their commune, Rhiain- a young druid and her master Gwen are forced to flee and traverse the wilds of Britannia in order to reach the sanctuary of the Druids - Ynys Môn. On their journey they will encounter great challenges and unlikely allies on a quest that will decide not only their survival, but the future of their way of life itself.

results.title: Siti Vampire
results.overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

results.title: Bodyman
results.overview: When Senate candidate Evelyn James is kidnapped during her political campaign, her disappearance exposes a dangerous secret buried beneath the very issues that have defined her public career.  A decorated Marine with a reputation for toughness, Evelyn refuses to remain a victim. After escaping captivity, she uncovers evidence of a powerful human-trafficking network connected to the death of her daughter - and discovers that influential figures are working from inside the system to protect those responsible.
